rules.spatial_region: validation if Source or Target 16x32 region is in deterministic held-region set
rules.block_holdout: endpoint closed bounding box intersects any configured Block
rules.rare_port_pair: full-port-pair public frequency <= 28, targeting at least 10% of rows
rules.boundary_holdout: minimum Source/Target distance to any chip side <= 8
rules.macro8_remainder_holdout: validation contains deterministic held-out (dx mod 8,dy mod 8) cells
rules.macro8_phase_holdout: validation if Source or Target absolute 8x8 phase is held out
rules.macro10_remainder_holdout: validation contains deterministic held-out (dx mod 10,dy mod 10) cells
rules.macro10_phase_holdout: validation if Source or Target absolute 10x10 phase is held out
